summary: Frontend-only regression test for the Dashboard rotation/refresh 'screen jumps on refresh' bug fix. All the applied fixes (60s rotation, scrollY>150 guard, silent background refresh at 30s, Loading pill only on initial load, updated label 'Auto-rotating every 60s') were verified working end-to-end at https://core-checks-only.preview.emergentagent.com using admin employee 4444. Tested on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard rotation/refresh 'jump' fix verified. Verifications performed: (a) All required data-testids present (section-btn-0/1/2, rotation-toggle-btn). (b) Label reads 'Auto-rotating every 60s' when not paused. (c) Loading pill did NOT reappear during 40s of background refresh in desktop and 35s in mobile - only initial load shows it. (d) On mobile (page scrollable, scrollHeight=1645), scrolled to Y=300, waited 35s across a background refresh: scrollY stayed at 300 (0px delta), no screen jump. (e) 'Last updated' timestamp advanced from 12:34:44 -> 12:35:14 confirming silent refresh actually ran without moving the viewport. (f) While scrolled (y=300 > 150), the active section did NOT change during the wait window (rotation correctly skipped due to scrollY guard). (g) Manual section switch (section-btn-1) works, shows 'Paused - tap Play to auto-rotate', and rotation-toggle-btn resumes with 'Auto-rotating every 60s'. (h) View All Checks button opens the modal. (i) Navigating /workplan -> / reloads the dashboard cleanly. Only issue: stale label 'Auto-updates every 10sec' at App.js:1702 should read '30sec'.
rca of the issue: Original bug: dashboard jumped/moved on refresh. Root cause was two-fold: (1) the 20s auto-rotation tick fired regardless of scroll position, snapping the carousel section and shifting the viewport while the user was reading below the fold; (2) the 10s background data refetch called fetchRecentChecklists() which unconditionally set isLoading=true, mounting the fixed 'Loading...' pill and, in some layouts, causing brief content re-render/scroll shift. Mitigation (already applied by main agent and verified here): slow rotation to 60s and gate the tick behind window.scrollY <= 150; slow background refresh to 30s and add silent=true flag so isLoading (and thus the Loading pill) is not toggled during background refreshes.
